title: Re-verify from primary source whether the Controls addon panel truly never shows argType descriptions, and whether the autodocs/Docs-page approach was the right path at all
objective: Owner asked to critically re-examine whether the whole prior investigation (Controls panel description-column claim sourced from web search, not Storybook's own bundled code; the autodocs/Docs-page path; the upstream-bug conclusion) was actually the right approach, rather than accepting the earlier conclusion at face value. Re-derive from Storybook's own bundled manager code (already available locally in node_modules) rather than secondary sources.
validations: DONE: found a real mistake in the prior investigation by re-deriving from Storybook's own bundled manager code (already present in node_modules) instead of trusting the earlier web-search-sourced claim that the Controls addon panel 'by design' never shows descriptions. Read the actual ArgsTable row-rendering code (common-manager.js:3039-3040): a `compact` prop, when true, skips the Description and Default-value <td> cells entirely -- but `compact` is NOT a hardcoded panel constant; it is computed as `compact: !expanded && hasControls` (line 3687) inside ControlsPanelTable, where `expanded` comes directly from `useParameter('controls', {})` (PARAM_KEY5 confirmed literally equal to the string 'controls').

DONE: this means `parameters.controls.expanded: true` -- an ordinary, first-class Storybook Controls addon parameter -- makes the addon panel itself render the full table (Name, Description, Default, Control), with zero dependency on autodocs or a Docs page at all. The entire autodocs detour (ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-AUTODOCS), the confirmed upstream Docs-page bug investigation (ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-DOCS-EMPTY), and the inline-Canvas-block workaround the owner rejected (ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-INLINE-DESCRIPTIONS) were all unnecessary detours from a one-line, fully-supported fix that was available from the start.
DONE: set `parameters.controls.expanded: true` in .storybook/preview.ts (replacing the removed `tags: ['autodocs']` and its now-inaccurate comment); restarted both dev servers fully.

DONE: re-verified the full chain -- /storybook page and /storybook-app proxy both 200; /index.json confirms sidebar is back to plain story entries only (no broken Docs entries); grepped the fresh log and found zero occurrences of the docsParameter.renderer error (only the pre-existing, harmless startup-race ECONNREFUSED); architecture-studio's own tsc --noEmit clean.
artifacts: apps/architecture-studio/.storybook/preview.ts (parameters.controls.expanded: true added; tags: ['autodocs'] and its now-inaccurate comment removed)
risks: Process note for the future: when a Storybook addon's behavior seems limited/by-design, check that addon's own documented `parameters.<addonKey>.*` options (and, when in doubt, the addon's actual bundled source, which is available locally in node_modules) before concluding a bigger feature (like a whole Docs page) is required -- this is exactly the check that was skipped initially and cost several detours to recover from.
